column5: You jump in every puddle in the park.
and your street is a river up to your knees.
Your neighbour rows to work in a little boat.
Water creeps in under the door.
Your kitchen table becomes an island.
Your whole town is under water.
You live on a roof now.
You can't even remember what the sun looks like.
About two hundred thirty million years ago,
Earth stayed wet for up to two million years.
And when it finally dried out…
